text: AAA closed at 120.50 PKR, up 1.2% on the day, volume 1.4M shares.
AAA board approved quarterly results: revenue up 8% year on year, interim cash dividend of 3.00 PKR per share.
AAA announced commissioning of a new production line, expected to raise capacity by 15%.
FUTURE ITEM: AAA reported a large one-off loss. Must never appear in a bundle as of 2025-06-30.
BBB closed at 45.10 PKR, down 2.5% on the day, volume 3.2M shares.
BBB disclosed a delay in its plant expansion due to equipment import restrictions.
BBB quarterly fundamentals: EPS 1.10 PKR, debt to equity 1.8, gross margin 14%.
CCC entered a strategic partnership with a regional distributor to expand exports.
CCC closed at 310.00 PKR, unchanged on the day, volume 0.2M shares.
Central bank cut the policy rate by 100 basis points to 11.00%.
CPI inflation for May came in at 3.5% year on year.
PKR closed at 283.50 per USD in the interbank market.
FUTURE ITEM: central bank raised the policy rate. Must never appear in a bundle as of 2025-06-30.
